parts.text:
Ticket 1 covers the frontend UI and API client for giving back a place, the backend endpoint and database queries handling cancellation and seat accounting, the meetup test suite proving the criteria, and the user documentation in the README.

Ticket 2 covers the frontend UI and API client for viewing attendees, the backend endpoint and database logic enforcing organiser-only visibility of attendee names, the meetup test suite proving the privacy criteria, and the user documentation in the README.
